_comment: It carries the run-level paths/knobs AND the selection, so one file drives a
Any value also given on the CLI (or via env) wins over this file, so you can
reuse it and override one thing:   ... --songs-json this.json --limit 2
out_dir <rescue dir, must differ from pass1_dir> - qf_ar/qf_nar <adapter
paths> - cot - adapter <label written to the sidecar> - threads - limit.
'songs' entries are a pass-1 NAME (rescues every take) or a full STEM
<name>_<seed> (one take), or an object {stem|name, note} (note is ignored by
the driver). Omit the 'songs' key entirely to rescue every track.

songs.note: arrangement good, pronunciation bad -> rescue this one
